references.text: This verse gives the original instructions for the dimensions of the boards of the tabernacle: ten cubits long and a half-cubit wide. Exodus 36:21 describes the execution of these instructions.
The cubit as a unit of measurement is also used for the ark of the covenant, showing the consistent use of measurements in the construction of the tabernacle.
Solomon's temple also used specific measurements in cubits for its construction, demonstrating continuity in Israelite building tradition from the tabernacle to the temple.
Ezekiel's temple vision also includes detailed measurements in cubits, linking back to the precise dimensions that were used in the tabernacle.
